description: List discussion topics in a group, returning id, title, message, posted_at, discussion_type, published, and is_announcement for each topic — replies are not included. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use get_group_discussion to fetch one topic in full detail including due/available dates, and list_discussions for the course-scoped equivalent; there is no group-scoped counterpart to post_discussion_entry or list_announcements.
name: list_group_discussions
title: List Group Discussions
